name: jev-compact
description: Jev-guided Codex compaction with exact post-compaction dedupe and observe mode.

interface.shortDescription: Restore only useful evidence missing after Codex compaction.
interface.longDescription: Uses Jev to select useful history before Codex compaction, verifies what survived native replacement_history, and restores only exact missing evidence. Observe mode measures the same pipeline without changing Codex context. Supports TypeSafe and OpenRouter with local metrics.
defaultPrompt: Show what Jev retained from the last compaction.
